_comment: Projects analysed by scripts/corpus.py. Small, self-contained, allocation-heavy
C libraries whose translation units build with a handful of -I flags. Each entry
names the files to analyse (globs, relative to the checkout) and the compiler
arguments passed after `--`. Keep this list short enough to run in a few
minutes; add a project when an RFC defers a question to corpus testing that

projects.name: sds
projects.notes: Simple dynamic strings: realloc-heavy, returns owned pointers with a header offset.

projects.name: cJSON
projects.notes: Tree of malloc'd nodes freed recursively; custom allocator hooks via function pointers.

projects.name: jsmn
projects.notes: Header-only parser; the examples are the translation units.

projects.name: log.c
projects.notes: Callbacks stored in a global table; FILE* borrowed across calls.

projects.name: printf
projects.notes: Pointer arithmetic over caller buffers with no allocation: a false-positive canary.

projects.name: linenoise
projects.notes: History as a global array of strdup'd strings; strdup/free through helpers.
